source_winner.old_familiar_topic: The person you love feels like home.

creator_anchor.text: khaali hai jo tere bina, main woh ghar hoon tera
creator_anchor.constraint: Use this supplied line only; do not add more lyrics.

illusion_of_novelty_model.new_reveal: The emptiness is visible in one kept place: even when alone, the speaker does not occupy the other person's side.
illusion_of_novelty_model.viewer_outcome: The viewer can send the carousel because it says the hollow part they cannot say cleanly: without you, even home is empty.
illusion_of_novelty_model.contrast_frame: The generic belief is that home is a feeling or a person; this version makes it physical by showing the exact side nobody else gets to occupy.

urgency.reason: No fake timeliness is needed; the real emotional window is missing someone while still keeping their place.

illusion_of_novelty_model.bullseye_proof: One partner remains on their own side even when alone, leaving the other side open and uncreased.
illusion_of_novelty_model.protect_the_illusion: Do not explain the philosophy of home. Let the kept place make the reader understand.

hook_diagnostic.why_winner_worked: The source winner proves short person-as-home recognition can travel; this remix keeps the recognition but adds a lived Aachu/Zuv receipt.

symptoms_to_check_without_becoming_rigid.delay: No issue if the empty side is visible immediately.
symptoms_to_check_without_becoming_rigid.confusion: Repair if the viewer cannot tell that the untouched side belongs to the missing person.
symptoms_to_check_without_becoming_rigid.weak_relevance: Repair if slide 2 reads like a general quote instead of a message to one person.
symptoms_to_check_without_becoming_rigid.low_curiosity: Repair if slide 1 is just text on a room and the viewer has no reason to swipe.

hook_diagnostic.non_rigid_decision: Preserve the creator lyric and the home/person winner engine, but make the A Story wrapper do the emotional proof.

a_story_translation.what_stays_from_source: The short, direct home/person landing mechanism and the sendable feeling of naming one person as home.
a_story_translation.what_changes_for_aachu_zuv: Aachu/Zuv make the premise visible through a shared sofa or bed side that remains untouched while one partner is away.
a_story_translation.lived_scene_wrapper: Slide 1 shows one partner alone but still sitting only on their own side. Slide 2 must be rewritten from the hollow ache of the Ghar line; it must not become an invitation to return tired or a neat reassurance.
lines_to_remove_because_they_explain_the: home is not a place, it is a person
this is what real love means
the moral is that small things matter
